top_signals.title: US bans MEXC crypto exchange over sanctions evasion, cybercrime links
top_signals.summary: The US Department of the Treasury has cut off the MEXC Global crypto exchange from the US financial system over sanctions evasion and links with cybercrime gangs. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Sticks With AI Playbook After Historic Tech Unwind
top_signals.summary: Hedge funds dumped technology stocks at one of the fastest paces on record last week, and the momentum crash that followed was the biggest in about 40 years. Even so, few on Wall Street are ready to call time on the AI boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
